note: Author direction at review of pilot block 1: a record that cannot be identified must not advance to Stage 2 as an include. Both records had metadata recovery attempted first, as directed. Neither resolved.

decisions.notes: UNRESOLVED. Title 'AttentionletIs All You Need!' is garbled and the Google Scholar capture (GS0550, query B3_memory_2) carries no authors, venue, year or citation count. Metadata recovery attempted 2026-07-31 against Semantic Scholar, Crossref and OpenAlex on three title variants; no index returned a plausible match. Held rather than advanced: the record cannot be identified, so there is no decision on the merits to record. Lookup failure is uninformative here because the title itself is corrupt.

UNRESOLVED. Google Scholar capture (GS0251, query B2_quantization_1) carries title only, no authors, venue or year. Metadata recovery attempted 2026-07-31 against Semantic Scholar, Crossref and OpenAlex; no index returns this as a research paper. Crossref's nearest neighbours are book chapters ('Chapter 9/10: LLMs and Quantization', Large Language Models for Developers, De Gruyter 2024), consistent with a tutorial or book chapter under exclusion 6, but the match is not exact enough to exclude on. Held for author direction.
